# uapi_diagnostics (Data Source)

Runtime diagnostics: loaded resources, uptime, lock state, and an optional sweep for sections a write would reject.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uapi_diagnostics" "now" {}

output "uapi_uptime" {
  value = data.uapi_diagnostics.now.uptime_seconds
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `validate` (Boolean) Run the validation sweep (`?validate=1`), populating `invalid_sections`, `swept_resources` and `skipped_for_scope`. Off by default: the sweep re-validates every section on the router, so it costs real work on each read.

### Read-Only

- `invalid_sections` (Attributes List) Sections a write would reject today, whether or not Terraform manages them. Populated only when `validate` is set. An empty list next to a non-empty `skipped_for_scope` means the token was not allowed to look, not that nothing is wrong. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invalid_sections))
- `lock_state` (Attributes) Current advisory lock holders. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lock_state))
- `management_path` (Attributes) Which interface this request arrived through. Absent when the inbound address or its route could not be determined. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--management_path))
- `recent_errors` (Attributes List) Best-effort sliding window of recent error responses (newest last). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recent_errors))
- `request_id` (String) Request id assigned to this diagnostics call.
- `resources_loaded` (List of String) Curated resource keys the server has loaded.
- `skipped_for_scope` (List of String) Resources left out because the token lacks `:ro` on them. Populated only when `validate` is set.
- `swept_resources` (List of String) Resources the sweep checked, in colon form. Populated only when `validate` is set.
- `uptime_seconds` (Number) Seconds since the router booted.
- `version` (String) uapi version string.

<a id="nestedatt--invalid_sections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invalid_sections`

Read-Only:

- `errors` (Attributes List) Why the section would be rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invalid_sections--errors))
- `id` (String) Section id.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the underlying uci section is uapi-managed.
- `resource` (String) Resource in slash form, e.g. `firewall/rules`.

<a id="nestedatt--invalid_sections--errors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invalid_sections.errors`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Error code.
- `field` (String) Offending field.
- `message` (String) Human-readable explanation.



<a id="nestedatt--lock_state"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lock_state`

Read-Only:

- `global_held` (Boolean) Whether the global uapi lock is held.
- `packages_held` (List of String) Packages whose per-package lock is held.


<a id="nestedatt--management_path"></a>
### Nested Schema for `management_path`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Inbound address the request arrived on.
- `device` (String) Kernel device carrying that address.
- `interface` (String) uci network interface owning the device, when one claims it.


<a id="nestedatt--recent_errors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recent_errors`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Error code.
- `message` (String) Error message.
- `method` (String) HTTP method.
- `path` (String) Request path.
- `request_id` (String) Request id of the failed request.
- `status` (Number) HTTP status.
- `ts` (Number) Unix epoch seconds when the error occurred.
